definitions.explanation: Effort made with difficulty or mental struggle. The process of working hard on something challenging.

examples.japanese: {苦心|くしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦ついに→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：01550_kansei⟧。
examples.english: After much effort, it was finally completed.
examples.notes: [Note: 苦心の末 = after great pains]

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦心|くしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: You can feel the author's painstaking effort in this work.

COMMON PATTERNS:

- {苦心|くしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|さく}→作：noentry⟧ (a work made with great effort)

- {苦心|くしん}⟦{惨憺|さんたん}→惨憺：27415_santan⟧ (working one's fingers to the bone)
